# Implementation plan: Console (dashboard v2)

**For:** `tasks/prd-cctop-dashboard-v2.md` v2.0 — nine user stories.
**Design:** the canvas *cctop Dashboard Redesign*, page *Console*; the clickable prototype at `tasks/design-dashboard-v2/prototype.html`. Every screen in it is generated by `proto/*.js` and measured on the character grid, so the layout constants below are transcribed, not estimated.
**Replaces:** `tasks/plan-dashboard-big-figures.md` §1 and §3. Its §2 one-object rule survives and is extended.
**Written:** 2026-09-16 · v2, after the dogfood chose Console and a pane-contract sweep corrected the geometry. §7 records what earlier drafts got wrong and why the order changed.

**Baseline:** `cargo test` on `78f8a2f` — 292 passed, 0 failed, 2 ignored, 5.1 s. Every "expect failures" below is against that.

## 1. The shape of the work

Two halves that ship independently.

**Part A — correctness.** US-101, US-104, US-105. Every measured finding in the PRD. No schema change, no layout change, no new key. Four commits, every boundary green, on the dashboard that exists today. Worth shipping whether or not Part B happens — that is the test of whether it was really the valuable half.

**Part B — Console.** US-102, US-103, US-109, then US-106 and US-108. The layout question is closed (PRD §10), so there is no comparison arm: the tiles go.

**What changed the order from v1.** The pane sweep found that the pane cannot express a colour ramp (PRD §3.6). That makes `stacked_bar`'s glyph defect — it alternates on the *input* index and `continue`s a zero-cell slice, so a three-slice bar on a session with no extended thinking draws two adjacent slices in the same glyph — the **only** thing standing between the pane and an unreadable context bar. It moves from a nicety in A4 to a blocker for US-109, and Part B cannot start without it.

| | Story | Ships | Size |
|---|---|---|---|
| A1 | US-101 | cost single-sourced, regenerated registry docs | S |
| A2 | US-101 | turn-state labels, the fixture behind them | S |
| A3 | US-104 | six honest figures, each with a test | M |
| A4 | US-105 | `Theme::series`, the `stacked_bar` fix, panel 1 only | M |
| B0 | US-108 (part) | `build-site.sh` fails loudly — **before** anything moves | XS |
| B1 | US-102 | schema 2, the digit decision, `--columns` avoided | M |
| B2 | US-103 + US-109 | both surfaces, one commit | L |
| B3 | US-106 | the rule line's key map | S |
| B4 | US-108 | README, site, guide, demo assets | M |

Dependencies: A4 before B2 (the glyph fix); B0 before B2 (or the public site documents a deleted UI); B1 before B2; B3 and B4 after B2. A1–A3 are independent of everything.

## 2. Part A — correctness

### A1 · Cost is not single-sourced across readers (US-101)

PRD §3.2. `Cost::current()` (`src/metrics/cost.rs:172–191`) has two branches; `$0.000` without `≈` is reachable only through the authoritative one with a near-zero total, `≈$22.5` needs `any_since`, and `src/metrics/cost.rs:138–142` sets the first while clearing the second. Two readers at different points in one transcript, 2250× apart.

- Reproduce: two readers over one transcript, one past the `cost-state` line and one before it; assert they agree.
- Fix in `src/metrics/cost.rs`. Either the authoritative branch keeps what it displaced, or a near-zero total on a session with real usage carries `≈` and the registry caveat. **Not in a renderer.**
- `cctop metrics --md > docs/metrics.md && cctop metrics --readme README.md` **in this commit**: `src/metrics/registry.rs:278` and `:289` are ordinary tests, and deferring the regeneration leaves `cargo test` red for whole phases.

**Done when** no pair of readers over one transcript reports two costs.

### A2 · Turn state says which question it answers (US-101)

`src/ui/panels/turn.rs:34` reads `state.agg.current_turn()`; `dashboard::header` takes the phase word from `coach::state_line` (`src/coach.rs:1038`). Both honest; only the labelling implies they should match.

- Capture a turn-ended-while-tools-run fixture with `scripts/anonymise-transcript.py` (never hand-edit structure — CLAUDE.md).
- Name each field for what it reads. A bug exists only if the fixture shows the classifier naming a phase with no tool activity and no open turn, and then it is in `src/phase.rs`.

### A3 · Honest figures (US-104)

| Fix | Where |
|---|---|
| velocity `—` until two samples | `src/metrics/context.rs`; the metric returns `Option`, the renderer prints `—` |
| cost labelled API-equivalent | `src/ui/panels/tokens.rs` and `src/dashboard.rs::row_tokens` |
| `8 stale` gains its noun and the `⚠` at ≥ 3 | `src/dashboard.rs`; threshold already in the registry |
| `4c +145` spelled out | `src/coach.rs:1107`, inside `pub fn state_line` (**not** `state_tokens`, which does not exist) |
| rework figure → a state word | `src/coach.rs` rework light |
| `159 api calls · 159 tool calls` | **investigate before writing a criterion.** "Confirmed or corrected" is a task, not a test. If genuinely equal here, the criterion is a fixture assertion; if one stands in for the other it is an A1-class bug |

Both coach changes invalidate the eight `src/ui/snapshots/cctop__ui__coach_view__tests__coach_*.snap` **and** the six `tests/pane/fixtures/coach-<moment>.json`, which `tests/pane/coach.test.ts` asserts row-for-row. Regenerate with `scripts/pane-fixtures.sh fixtures/session-b.jsonl b` in the same commit.

### A4 · The series ramp and the glyph fix (US-105)

A new module: there is no colour crate in `Cargo.toml` and no OKLab code in the repo.

1. **Fix `stacked_bar` first** (`src/ui/widgets.rs:29–62`). Alternate on **emitted** segments, not on the input index, and do not let a zero-cell slice consume an alternation. Test the zero-middle-slice case under `Caps { mono: true }` — this is the FR-9 test and it is what the pane depends on entirely.
2. `Theme::series(n)` from the **unreduced** accent. `Theme::for_caps` (`src/theme.rs:258–282`) consumes `self` and rewrites each field, so a ramp derived after reduction reads a `Color::Indexed` with no RGB. Keep `Caps` or the source accent on `Theme`.
3. Pin the six bundled hexes against `tasks/design-dashboard-v2/series-ramp.mjs`; properties alone let the Rust ramp drift from every mockup and from PRD §5.2.
4. `series(3)` through `to_ansi16` for all six themes, asserting three distinct results — or declare 16-colour glyph-only and let step 1 carry it.
5. Apply to **panel 1's existing five-slice bar only.** Console's three-slice bar is B2.

## 3. Part B — Console

### B0 · Make the site fail loudly (XS, first)

`.github/workflows/pages.yml` deploys `site/` on every push to `main`, and `scripts/build-site.sh` cannot fail: its `re.sub` calls match nothing silently and its two `re.search` extractions yield `""`. The moment B2 lands, the public site documents a UI that does not exist.

Make zero matches exit non-zero **now**, while it is a no-op. There are **five** layout-coupled regexes, not four: `:44` ledger digits, `:45` light names, `:46` the nudge, `:47` the footer, `:51` the panel-view card (safe — the coach view is unchanged — but it must be named), plus the `re.search` fences at `:42` and `:49`, plus `:38`'s `kv["bg"]`.

### B1 · The object (US-102)

`src/dashboard.rs`, schema `1 → 2` (current value verified at `:203`).

**Settle the digit question before writing the schema.** `Cell.key` is a wire field; carrying an undecided one through a public bump means schema 3 within the week. PRD §6.2 settles it: contiguous `1`–`6` one per cell, `a` for the act line, `0` for home. Nothing else claims a digit.

Out: `tiles: Vec<Tile>`, `Tile`, `ROW_WIDTH` as a constant.
In: `cells: Vec<Cell>`, `act: Act`, `body: Body`, and `Slice { label, tokens, step: u8 }`.

**The object stops being width-aware, rather than becoming more so.** v1's plan added `snapshot(state, engine, width)` and had no caller story: `src/query.rs:394` is `pub fn dashboard(state)` with no width, `src/main.rs:114` declares `Dashboard` as a bare unit variant with no flags, and `plugin/hooks/poller.ts:135` sends `--session` and `--surface` on a 2 s/10 s timer while the pane's real width arrives at render time (`pane.tsx:506`) and is `null` before the first render. So: **`snapshot` emits full-length lines and each surface cuts once at its own width.** That removes the double cut with no new flag, no resize re-poll, and no rows cut for a stale width.

Also here: `src/query.rs`, `docs/query.md:47`, and `src/main.rs:114`'s clap help (mirrored as a literal in `tests/pane/poller.test.ts:26`).

**Schema policy.** Bump and say so in `docs/query.md`. There is no deprecation window *by version pin* because no pin exists — `plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json` carries only the plugin's own version and the pane probes `cctop query --help` (`poller.ts:55–67`, `model.ts:334–342`). The window is provided instead by FR-16: the pane reads `schema` and renders one line naming the cctop it needs. Land that read in B1 so it is in place before the shape changes.

Regenerate `scripts/pane-fixtures.sh` for both fixtures; `tests/pane/overview.test.ts` goes red here and is fixed in B2 — which is why B1 and B2 are one shippable unit (§4).

### B2 · Both surfaces, one commit (US-103, US-109)

**TUI — `src/ui/dashboard.rs`.** Delete `tile_block`, `tile_rows`, `FOUR_TILES`, `TWO_TILES`, `L1_TILES`, `TILE_WIDTH`, and `big_digits` + `BIG` + `mod big_tests` in `src/ui/widgets.rs` (sole caller is `tile_rows`). **But `TWO_TILES` and `L1_TILES` gate ledger decisions, not tile ones** — `with_detail = width >= TWO_TILES` (`:236`) and the narrow `ledger_row` form (`:230`, `:189–194`) — so they need replacements. Column stops from the prototype:

```
cells      per row: 3 at >= 80 body columns, else 2
cell width: floor((cols - 2) / perRow)
cell text : "wide" at >= 80, "mid" at cell width >= 28, else "short"
act line  : right-aligned tail at >= 66, shortened copy below 72
```

**Pane — `plugin/hooks/views/overview.tsx`.** Delete `tileRows`, `tileLines`, `engineTiles`, `TILES_MIN`, `L2_MAX`, `type Tile`, `tileOf`, and `dashboardOf`'s hard `if (!Array.isArray(tiles)) return null`. `TILES_MIN` also gates the pane's detail rows at `:635`. `frame.tsx`'s `bigDigits` / `BIG_GLYPHS` goes **in this commit** — it is live, not dead: imported at `overview.tsx:17`, called at `:569`, asserted at `tests/pane/overview.test.ts:20,127–139`.

A cell is a keyed `Box` of `plain` Buttons sharing a `scope` and one `onPress`; the padding is a Button so that clicking it counts. The digit is the engine's rendering — cctop draws none.

The pane's digit model changes with it: `Model.unfolded` (`model.ts:113,186`), `overview.toggle` (`:145,301–305`), `viewOfDigit` (`overview.tsx:717`), dispatcher `pane.tsx:253–255`.

**Build the row-identity harness.** It does not exist: `coach.test.ts` covers the Coach card, `overview.test.ts` uses fixture **A** and regexes rather than Rust-rendered rows, and the `-b` dashboard fixtures are generated but read by no test. Pin it at 54, 67 and 85 — the widths the dock actually gives.

**Tests that break and are not snapshots:**
- `src/theme.rs:532` — `assert!(text.contains("1 Context"))` inside `dashboard_no_color_is_monochrome`. `INSTA_UPDATE` will not fix it.
- `src/dashboard.rs:922–1022` — asserts `rows.len() == 9`, `digit == i+1`, both `ROW_WIDTH` bounds, `tiles.len() == 4`, `schema == 1`.
- `tests/pane/overview.test.ts` — nine tests. (Not `fixtures.test.ts`, which only JSON-parses and keeps passing.)

**Regeneration, in order:**

```
cargo test                                        # expect failures; read them
INSTA_UPDATE=always cargo test                    # accept; strip `assertion_line:`, delete *.snap.new
scripts/pane-fixtures.sh
scripts/pane-fixtures.sh fixtures/session-b.jsonl b
npm run typecheck && npm test
make check
```

**Live checks** (CLAUDE.md: never marked passed by automation) → `docs/verification/pane.md` as `Result: pending`: a `plain` Button with no hotkey; the hover scope over a spaces-only Button; six Buttons each claiming a bare digit; the real `bodyColumns` at 35 / 54 / 67 / 85.

### B3 · The rule line's key map (US-106)

`Body::keys` is already on the object from B1, so there is no new trait and no `Panel::keys`. `?` expands the rule line into the open body's full key map and collapses again. Console has no footer, so the three legacy footer strings reduce to two: `src/ui/coach_view.rs:26` and the hard-coded one at `src/app.rs:815`.

- `README.md` `## What it looks like` regenerated from the real renderer (`cctop run --once --session fixtures/session-b.jsonl --size 85x24`), and the `panels:start` table reworded — nine panels become eight bodies.

- `site/index.template.html`: §2's heading "Four lights, one nudge, nine rows", the tile paragraph, the `tiles` and `▸` list items, Fig. 2's caption, `:95`'s "How to read it", `:203`'s "two-tiles-a-row layout", §3's `○ ◐ ●` symbol note, and Fig. 1's alt text.
- `plugin/README.md:35,44` — marketplace-shipped text.
- `src/query.rs:392` doc comment; module docs at `src/dashboard.rs:1–6`, `src/ui/dashboard.rs:1–8`, `src/ui/widgets.rs:120`.
- `scripts/build-guide.py:248, 251–252, 382`. The `coach_*` sample lines at `:239–242` are the coach view's and **stay** — the coach view does not change.

- **`og-image.png` does not show the dashboard** — `brand/svg/cctop-og.svg` is the logo on a flat rect (`brand/build.ts:134`). Struck from the list.

Assets, on a machine with the tools:

`make demo` regenerates `two-pane.png/webp`, six `theme-*.png`, `demo.gif/webm`. **Make it runnable in CI first — it is three lines.** `scripts/demo.py` resolves Chrome from a hardcoded list plus `shutil.which`, and ffmpeg from `shutil.which("ffmpeg")`. A Claude Code web container ships both, off `PATH`: Chromium at `$PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH/chromium-*/chrome-linux/chrome` (141.0.7390.37, verified) and ffmpeg at `$PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH/ffmpeg-*/ffmpeg-linux`. Add those globs and an `FFMPEG` env override beside the existing `CCTOP` one. `cwebp` is genuinely absent and needs a Pillow fallback or stays local. `site/demo.tape`'s key sequence changes with the bodies.

Until that lands, split US-108 into "regenerate text" (anywhere) and "regenerate assets" (a machine with the four tools), and **do not tick the asset criteria on a container run**.

## 4. Shippable boundaries

Every boundary below is green except one, and that one is named rather than discovered:

| after | `cargo test` | `npm test` | site correct |
|---|---|---|---|
| A1 · A2 · A3 · A4 | green | green | yes |
| B0 | green | green | yes |
| **B1** | green | **red** — `overview.test.ts` | yes |
| B2 | green | green | **no** — until B4 |
| B3 | green | green | no |
| B4 | green | green | yes |

B1 and B2 are therefore **one push**, not two commits on `main`: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` runs the pane job on every push. B2 through B4 leave the site describing a UI that has shipped-but-not-been-documented, which B0's assertion makes loud rather than silent — the build fails, so the window is bounded and visible.

## 5. Risks and decisions to take early

- **The digit question is a schema field.** Settle it in B1 (PRD §6.2 does) or pay schema 3.
- **A4 gates B2.** Without the `stacked_bar` fix the pane's context bar is unreadable on any session without extended thinking, and the pane has no colour to fall back on.
- **`make demo` cannot run everywhere**; do not mark US-108 done on a container run.
- **Config migration.** The pattern and its test already exist: `src/config.rs:13,17` still parse `layout` and `hidden_panels`, `src/app.rs:149` documents them as read and ignored, and `src/theme.rs:563–570` asserts it. Any persisted Console state copies that shape and that test.
- **Release ordering.** `Cargo.toml`, `plugin.json` and the tap formula update independently — the coach round-2 handoff records exactly that drift. A schema bump is the one release where they must not.
- **Performance.** `compose()` runs at up to 4 Hz (`REFRESH_MIN_MS = 100`, `src/app.rs:26`). Console builds one body instead of nine rows plus details, so this should improve; measure rather than assume.
- **Rustfmt reformats whole files**; fold the drift in.
- Commit subjects: `Dashboard: …`, `Theme: …`, `Metrics: …`, `Pane: …`, `Docs: …`, `Site: …`.

## 7. What earlier drafts got wrong

Kept for provenance; both earlier versions are in this file's history.

| Claim | Verdict |
|---|---|
| "Cost is already single-sourced — do not go looking for a bug" | **Backwards.** Both readings were on one screen, so the readers were not on one `State`. Now A1 |
| "the pane ships pinned to a cctop version" | **False** — no pin; the pane probes `query --help`. FR-16 provides the window instead |
| "`src/mcp.rs`'s `cctop_dashboard`" | **Does not exist.** Eight tools, none is the dashboard |
| "`frame.tsx`'s block-digit helper is already dead" | **False** — live in `overview.tsx` and asserted in tests |
| "clipped again at the terminal edge with no marker" | **False** — `spans()` cuts with `fmt::clip`, which appends `…`. The defect is two cuts at two widths, both marked |
| "none on any table" (filter), "`s`/`S` on the ledger only" | **False** — tools, files, events and the ledger all have keys |
| "`stacked_bar` unchanged (it already alternates)" | **Insufficient**, and now a blocker: it alternates on the input index and skips zero-cell slices |
| "degrade through the existing `Caps` path" | **Assumption** — `for_caps` consumes `self`; no RGB after reduction |
| "`state_tokens`", "`dashboard_json`" | Neither exists (`state_line`, `dashboard`) |
| `snapshot(state, engine, width)` | **No caller could supply it.** The object stops cutting instead (B1) |
| Screens captioned "the pane" at 122 columns | **The pane is 35–85 and never 122** (PRD §3.6) |
| `layout = tiles \| zones` comparison arm | **Dropped** — the dogfood happened (PRD §10) |
| Four regexes in `build-site.sh` | Five, plus two silent `re.search` fences |
| "each phase ships" | Three of six boundaries were red; §4 names the one that still is |
